query: Write unit tests for def parse_duration(value: str) -> int that converts '15m', '2h', '1d' (case and whitespace insensitive) to seconds and raises ValueError for '', '15', '0h', '1w', '-1h'.
expected_behavior: Uses pytest.mark.parametrize for valid and invalid inputs, in separate tests
Uses pytest.raises(ValueError) for the invalid cases
Includes the whitespace and case variant from the spec
Has no loops or conditionals inside the test body

query: Test that load_config(path) raises ValueError with message "missing 'freshness_column'" when a table has no freshness column.
expected_behavior: Uses pytest.raises with match= instead of comparing exc.value.args[0] with ==
Escapes or otherwise safely handles regex characters in the message
Tests one failure per with-block or per test

query: Write a test for send_report() in reports/mailer.py which does `from smtp_client import send` and calls send(body). I don't want a real email sent.
expected_behavior: Patches the name where it is looked up (reports.mailer.send), not smtp_client.send
Asserts the call arguments with assert_called_once_with or call_args
Does not perform network access

query: Test save_snapshot(directory) which writes snapshot-<today>.json into a directory and returns the path.
expected_behavior: Uses the tmp_path fixture, not a hardcoded /tmp path or manual shutil cleanup
Freezes or injects the clock instead of reading the real date
Asserts on the returned path and the written content

query: Write a unit test for normalize_columns(df) which renames DataFrame columns to snake_case.
expected_behavior: Reads the PySpark reference before writing
Uses a shared session-scoped spark fixture, not a new SparkSession inside the test
Builds the input DataFrame with an explicit schema or column list
Compares columns or sorted rows, not unordered collect() output
Flags the loop and conditional inside the test and recommends parametrize
Flags the try/except that can never fail and recommends pytest.raises
Flags the uninformative test name
Does not rewrite unrelated code

expected_behavior: Mirrors the source tree: tests/billing/test_invoice.py
Names tests test_<function>_<scenario>

query: Write a unit test for publish_events(topic) which reads KAFKA_BROKERS from the environment, builds a KafkaProducer from kafka and sends each event from get_events() with producer.send(topic=..., value=...). No real Kafka.
expected_behavior: Reads the mocking reference before writing
Sets env vars with monkeypatch.setenv or patch.dict(os.environ, ..., clear=True), not real values
Patches KafkaProducer where publish_events looks it up
Asserts the exact send calls (call_args_list or assert_has_calls), not mock.called alone

query: Test fetch_all(client_factory) which does `with client_factory() as c:` and then calls c.get_page(n) until it raises NotFound; it returns the list of pages fetched.
expected_behavior: Mocks the context manager through __enter__.return_value
Uses side_effect with a list ending in the exception to simulate pages then NotFound
Asserts the returned pages and the get_page call sequence
